sections.heading: Plants Make Food
sections.body: Plants make food. They use the sun. This is called photosynthesis. Remember: plants need sun to live.
sections.visual_hint: photo of a plant in sunlight

sections.heading: Plants Need Help
sections.body: Plants need water. Plants need air. Plants need sunlight. Remember: plants need three things.
sections.visual_hint: photo of someone watering a plant

sections.heading: Plants Give Us Air
sections.body: Plants make oxygen. Oxygen is the air we breathe. We need plants to live. Remember: plants help us breathe.
sections.visual_hint: photo of a child breathing fresh air near plants

key_terms.definition: plants making food from the sun
